{{quote|Delivers its bearer visions of the past. Cranky. Only works when it wants to.|Item description}}
<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a quest item from the [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It is given to the player by [[Marquis Teodoro Jr.]] after building the garden and obtaining 7 total people in the [[Refugee camp]]. Once [[Master Alaric]] explains the use of the item after his identity is uncovered, it allows the player to "see" scenes from the past by interacting with pink memory clouds. {{PAGENAME}} must be in the player's main inventory (not a bag) to see the memory clouds. 

==Main Questline==

To help Alaric figure out how to stop the Ancient Curse, the player must search for leads on the vampires who attacked the [[Astrologer]]. On the eastern side of the waterfall, west of the [[Beekeeping|Apiary]] area, the Keeper can view a series of nine total memories of the Astrologer and the former Graveyard Keeper partying. After the final memory, a dig spot appears and the [[Vampires jaw]] can be unearthed.

==Trivia==
*The memory in Krezvold's courtyard is likely a reference to Terraria, as all 3 items mentioned match the names of items in said game.
